summary: Verified the 3 Intel backend fixes against the preview pod. FIX 1 (skills/search territory + diacritic-insensitive): all 4 queries ('Malaga', 'Málaga', 'Andalucía', 'Castilla la mancha') return total=500 with has_domain=false; Andalucía expansion confirmed — all 5 sample results reference Andalusian provinces (Sevilla/Málaga/Cádiz/etc.), proving CCAA→provincias expansion works. FIX 2 (procurement/overview parallel + cache): HTTP 200, all 15 top-level keys and all 11 field_coverage keys present, contracts_with_nif==field_coverage.awardee_tax_id.count (612379); cache is very effective — first call 3.91s, second call 0.07s (~55x speedup). FIX 3 (procurement/status): endpoint is auth-protected (Depends(get_current_user)), so without credentials it returns 401 — not a regression, since the fix (estimated_document_count + cache) is internal.

minor.issue: Endpoint requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)) despite living under the /public-procurement prefix. Review request assumed it was public; test skipped because no credentials available. If public access is desired, remove the auth dependency; otherwise the review request wording is misleading. FIX 3 code path itself was not exercised end-to-end from this test.

Minor schema note: field_coverage.awardee_tax_id (and likely other field_coverage keys) is a dict {count, pct}, not a bare int. Review request implied a bare int equality with contracts_with_nif — the actual invariant holds via .count. Consumers must be aware of this shape.

action_items: Clarify FIX 3 scope: either make /public-procurement/status public (drop Depends(get_current_user)) or supply auth credentials so it can be tested end-to-end. As written the review request expected 200 without auth.
Optionally document that field_coverage.* values are {count, pct} dicts (not scalars) so the invariant contracts_with_nif == field_coverage.awardee_tax_id.count is explicit.
critical_code_review_comments: procurement.py: /status carries auth dependency while sibling /overview under the same /public-procurement prefix does not — inconsistent public/private split under a 'public' prefix is confusing.
skills_search.py fix works well; territory expansion for CCAA is effective and diacritic-insensitive regex verified for both 'Malaga' and 'Málaga'.

Overview cache TTL yields dramatic speedup (3.91s→0.07s); consider adding a short comment on TTL and invalidation strategy so future edits don't accidentally serve stale field_coverage after ingestion.
test_credentials: None used — endpoints under test are public except /status which is auth-protected (skipped).
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only tests against existing pod data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_intel_fixes.py -v -s . All skills/search assertions use filters.has_domain=false because pod only has 2 companies with domains — using default (has_domain=true) returns ~0 and is NOT a bug. /public-procurement/status needs a valid Bearer token to be exercised.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Both apparent 'failures' during the first test run were test-authoring issues (dict vs int for field_coverage.awardee_tax_id, and assumption that /status is public). Fixed the test and the underlying fixes verify correctly.
